list.title: Workshops
list.maxDiscountHint: Promotions that can be combined add up when a guest uses all of them. A promotion marked "Only this promotion" cannot be added to the others, so each one is shown on its own.
list.combinedLabel: {count, plural, one {The promotion that can be combined} other {All # promotions can be combined}}
list.deactivateBlocked: A workshop can only be deactivated when all its sessions are closed. {count, plural, one {# session is not closed yet.} other {# sessions are not closed yet.}}
list.editLocked: Only deactivated workshops can be edited. Deactivate it first.
list.activated: Workshop activated: it now shows on your landing page.
list.deactivated: Workshop deactivated: it no longer shows on your landing page.
list.statusFailed: The status could not be changed.
list.newHint: A new workshop is saved as a draft. Activate it from the list when it is ready.
list.createdSim: Workshop created as a draft (demo mode: not persisted). Activate it from the list when it is ready.
list.editHint: Update the details and the schedule of this workshop. A workshop can only be edited while it is deactivated.
list.noMatch: No workshops match your search or filter.

form.contentHint: Write the text per language. The default language is required; other enabled languages are recommended.
form.title: Title
form.notesHint: For example what to wear or bring.
form.missingTitle: Some enabled languages are missing translations
form.missingHint: Guests who use these languages will see the default language instead.
form.currencyHint: The currency follows the shop settings.
form.priceChangeNote: A new price only applies to new bookings. Existing bookings keep their price.
form.capacityHint: The seats a new session starts with, from 1 to {max}. You can still change it for each session.
form.maxPerBookingHint: The most seats one guest can book in a single booking. At least 1, and not more than the default capacity.
form.sortOrderHint: Sets the order of your workshops in the list and on your landing page. A smaller number comes first.
form.imagesHint: One cover image and up to {max} gallery images.
form.uploaderStub: Image upload is not available yet. Paste image URLs below for now.
form.hasBookings: This workshop has {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}}. Workshops cannot be deleted: deactivate it in the list to take it off your landing page.
form.noDelete: Workshops cannot be deleted. Deactivate a workshop in the list to take it off your landing page.
form.savedSim: Saved (demo mode: changes are not persisted).
form.statusFromList: Change it with Activate / Deactivate in the workshop list.

errors.titleRequired: A title in the default language is required.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a price of zero or more.
errors.durationRange: Duration must be a whole number between 15 and 600 minutes.
errors.capacityRange: Capacity must be a whole number between 1 and 50.
errors.maxPerBookingRange: Must be at least 1 and not more than the capacity.
errors.galleryMax: You can add up to 6 gallery images.
errors.timesRequired: Add at least one start time.
errors.toBeforeFrom: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.duplicateSession: A session for this workshop already exists at that time.
errors.capacityBelowReserved: Capacity cannot be lower than the {reserved} seats already reserved.
errors.cutoffInvalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 10080.
errors.pastStart: The start cannot be in the past. Choose a later date and time.

rules.title: Schedule rules
rules.hint: Rules generate sessions for the next 60 days. Start times are in {tz}.
rules.empty: No schedule rules yet. Add a rule or create one-off sessions.
rules.generateNote: Saving or removing a rule regenerates future sessions that have no bookings. Sessions that already have bookings are never changed or deleted.
rules.changedSim: Rule changed (demo mode: sessions are not regenerated).
rules.timesHint: Start times use the shop timezone ({tz}).
rules.toHint: Optional. Leave empty for no end date.
rules.capacityOverrideHint: Optional. Replaces the workshop default for these sessions.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.statusNote: New sessions are Open and can only be started. Start makes a session Running, so guests can book it. A running session can only be paused. From Paused you can start it again or close it for good. A session closed before it starts can be re-opened (back to Open).
sessions.cutoffHint: Online booking closes this many minutes before the session starts. Use 0 to close it when the session starts.
sessions.cutoffInfo: Booking closes {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before start
sessions.autoClosedNote: Automatically closed because the session time has ended.
sessions.closeWait: Wait until the session time has ended before you can close it.
sessions.closeHint: Please tell us why you are closing this session before it starts.
sessions.rescheduleHint: Choose the new date and time (times in {tz}). The length of the session stays the same.
sessions.rescheduleBookings: {count, plural, =0 {No guests have booked this session.} one {# booking will move to the new time and its guest will get an email.} other {# bookings will move to the new time and their guests will get an email.}}
sessions.rescheduled: Session re-scheduled. {count, plural, =0 {No guest needed an email.} one {# guest was emailed.} other {# guests were emailed.}}
sessions.rescheduleMailFailed: The session was re-scheduled, but the emails to the guests could not be queued. Please contact the guests yourself.
sessions.rescheduleSame: Choose a different date or time.
sessions.reschedulePast: The new start must be in the future.
sessions.imageHint: One image for this session. Guests see it next to the time on your landing page.
sessions.cloneHint: A new session like {code}: same workshop, capacity, cut-off and image. Choose its date and time (times in {tz}).
sessions.editHint: Change the details of {code}. The date and time cannot be changed here: use Re-schedule for a paused session.
sessions.workshopLocked: The workshop cannot be changed because this session has bookings.
sessions.checkInHint: Guests who booked this session. Check in each guest who arrives; use Uncheck-in to undo a mistake.
sessions.noBookings: No guests have booked this session.
sessions.checkInFailed: This guest cannot be changed right now.
sessions.checkInReadOnly: This session is closed, so the list is read-only. Each booking shows the status it had when the session closed.
sessions.rescheduleLimit: A session can be re-scheduled at most 3 times, and this session has already been re-scheduled 3 times.
sessions.closeLimit: A session can be closed at most 4 times, and this session has already been closed 4 times.
sessions.closeFinalWarning: This is the last time you can close this session. It will be closed for good: you cannot re-open it, and only a system administrator can open it again.
sessions.closedForGood: Closed for good. Only a system administrator can open this session again.
sessions.closedNotified: Session closed. {count, plural, =0 {No guest needed an email.} one {# guest was emailed.} other {# guests were emailed.}}
sessions.closeMailFailed: The session was closed, but the emails to the guests could not be queued. Please contact the guests yourself.
sessions.autoClosedNotified: Sessions closed automatically because their time ended. {count, plural, one {# guest was emailed.} other {# guests were emailed.}}
sessions.checkInRules: A guest who has not confirmed the booking by email can still be checked in. Uncheck-in puts the booking back to the status it had before the check-in.
sessions.paymentHint: Confirm the payment of each guest who paid at the studio. The guest is emailed when a booking becomes Paid. The booking is also set to Checked in.
sessions.paymentFailed: The payment could not be changed.
sessions.paymentMailNone: This guest left no email, so nothing was sent.
sessions.paymentMailFailed: The email could not be sent.
sessions.completeHint: Check the payment of every booking, then press Completed to finish the session. The booking is also set to Checked in.
sessions.completedHint: This session is Completed: it and its payments can no longer be changed.
sessions.completeConfirmText: Once the session is Completed, it and its bookings and payments can no longer be changed. The payment information will be used for statistics and to confirm the total amount payable for the platform fee.
sessions.bulkDone: {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} confirmed. Emails sent: {sent}. Without email: {none}. Failed: {failed}.
